using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int mod=1e9+7;

struct Matrix {
    int m[33][33];
} identity, a[70], result, prefix[70], suffix[70];

ll N, K;

void printMatrix(Matrix x){
    for(int i=0; i<=K; i++){
        for(int j=0; j<=K; j++)
            cout << x.m[i][j] << ' ';
        cout << endl;
    }
    cout << endl;
}

Matrix multiply(Matrix a, Matrix b){
    Matrix c=identity;
    for(int k=0; k<=K; k++){
        for(int i=0; i<=K; i++){
            for(int j=0; j<=K; j++){
                ll tmp = ((ll)a.m[i][k] * b.m[k][j]) % mod;
                c.m[i][j] = (c.m[i][j] + tmp) % mod;
            }
        }
    }
    return c;
}

void computePrefixSuffix(){
    int i;
    prefix[0] = a[0];
    for(i=1; i<K; i++)
        prefix[i] = multiply(prefix[i-1], a[i]);
    suffix[K-1] = a[K-1];
    for(i=K-2; i>=0; i--)
        suffix[i] = multiply(a[i], suffix[i+1]);
    a[0] = suffix[0];
    for(i=1; i<K; i++)
        a[i] = multiply(suffix[i], prefix[i-1]);
}

void process(){
    cin >> N >> K;
    int i, j;
    result = identity;
    for(i=0; i<K; i++){
        a[i] = identity;
        for(j=0; j<=K; j++)
            a[i].m[j][j] = 1;
        for(j=0; j<=K; j++)
            a[i].m[j][i] = 1;
        result.m[i][i] = 1;
    }
    result.m[K][K] = 1;
    while(N > 0){
        int t = N % K;
        if(t){
            ll pos=0, tmp=N;
            while(tmp){
                tmp /= K;
                pos = (pos + tmp) % K;
            }
            for(i=t-1; i>=0; i--){
                result = multiply(a[(pos + i) % K], result);
            }
        }
        computePrefixSuffix();
        N /= K;
    }
    int answer=1;
    for(i=0; i<K; i++)
        answer = (answer + result.m[K][i]) % mod;
    cout << answer << endl;
}

int main(){
    process();
    return 0;
}
